name: Anti-Grav Boots
d: At the start of each of the wearer's turns, SPD Amplification increases by 12%. This effect is stackable.

name: Anti-Grav Boots: Privilege
d: At the start of each of the wearer's turns, SPD Amplification increases by 24%. This effect is stackable.

name: Firestorm Surge
d: After each attack by the wearer, their On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by 6%. This effect is stackable.

name: Firestorm Surge: Privilege
d: After each attack by the wearer, their On-Field/Off-Field Strength increases by 12%. This effect is stackable.

name: Electromagnetic Catapult
d: At the start of the battle, the wearer's action advances by 100%.

name: Electromagnetic Catapult: Privilege
d: At the start of the battle, the wearer's action advances by 100%.

name: Chasing Stars
d: After attacking, the wearer inflicts "Fragility" on the target, increasing their DMG taken by 35% for 2 turn(s).

name: Chasing Stars: Privilege
d: After attacking, the wearer inflicts "Fragility" on the target, increasing their DMG taken by 70% for 2 turn(s).

name: Meteor Wings
d: Increases all allies' SPD Amplification by 15%. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

name: Meteor Wings: Privilege
d: Increases all allies' SPD Amplification by 30%. After the wearer uses their Ultimate, recovers 1 Skill Point(s).

name: Light Speed Propeller
d: During combat, for every 10 SPD the wearer has, they gain 2% On-Field Strength and 1% Off-Field Strength.

name: Light Speed Propeller: Privilege
d: During combat, for every 10 SPD the wearer has, they gain 4% On-Field Strength and 2% Off-Field Strength.

name: Starfaring Boots
d: Greatly increases SPD Amplification. At the start of each of the wearer's turns, regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to 10% of Max Energy. (Unique)

name: Starfaring Boots: Privilege
d: Greatly increases SPD Amplification. At the start of each of the wearer's turns, regenerates a fixed amount of Energy equal to 20% of Max Energy. (Unique)

name: Starcleaver Blade
d: Greatly increases On-Field Strength. DMG dealt by the wearer becomes 115% of the original DMG.

name: Starcleaver Blade: Privilege
d: Greatly increases On-Field Strength. DMG dealt by the wearer becomes 130% of the original DMG.

name: Weapon Master
d: Increases ally squad's On-Field/Off-Field Strength by 25%.

name: Weapon Master: Privilege
d: Increases ally squad's On-Field/Off-Field Strength by 50%.

name: High-frequency Chainsaw
d: At the start of the battle, if the wearer is on-field, increases their Lucky Strike DMG by 10%.

name: High-frequency Chainsaw: Privilege
d: At the start of the battle, if the wearer is on-field, increases their Lucky Strike DMG by 20%.

name: Bloodthirsty
d: After the wearer defeats an enemy, gains 1 stack(s) of "Red Eye": DMG Amplification increases by 8% and HP Amplification increases by 4%. In each battle, starts with 3 stack(s) of "Red Eye."

name: Bloodthirsty: Privilege
d: After the wearer defeats an enemy, gains 1 stack(s) of "Red Eye": DMG Amplification increases by 16% and HP Amplification increases by 8%. In each battle, starts with 3 stack(s) of "Red Eye."

name: Confidence Injector
d: When the wearer uses an ability on an ally target, increases their On-Field Strength by 30% and grants 10% DMG Mitigation for 2 turn(s).

name: Confidence Injector: Privilege
d: When the wearer uses an ability on an ally target, increases their On-Field Strength by 60% and grants 20% DMG Mitigation for 2 turn(s).

name: Momentum Edge
d: At the start of the wearer's turn, recovers 2 Skill Point(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed by the wearer, DMG Amplification increases by 2%.

name: Momentum Edge: Privilege
d: At the start of the wearer's turn, recovers 3 Skill Point(s). For every 1 Skill Point consumed by the wearer, DMG Amplification increases by 4%.

name: Codex of Combat
d: The wearer gains 7% SPD Amplification and 7% DMG Amplification. When the wearer is 2/3-star or higher, these amplifications respectively increase to 3/6 times their original values.

name: Codex of Combat: Privilege
d: The wearer gains 14% SPD Amplification and 14% DMG Amplification. When the wearer is 2/3-star or higher, these amplifications respectively increase to 3/6 times their original values.

name: Orbital Railgun
d: Greatly increases Off-Field Strength. DMG dealt by the wearer is 115% of the original DMG.

name: Orbital Railgun: Privilege
d: Greatly increases Off-Field Strength. DMG dealt by the wearer is 130% of the original DMG.

name: Starfall Sniper
d: At the start of the battle, if the wearer is off-field, increases their Lucky Strike DMG by 10%.

name: Starfall Sniper: Privilege
d: At the start of the battle, if the wearer is off-field, increases their Lucky Strike DMG by 20%.

name: Bastion Projector
d: At the start of the wearer's turn, provides a Shield equal to 30% of the wearer's Max HP to all on-field allies for 2 turn(s).

name: Bastion Projector: Privilege
d: At the start of the wearer's turn, provides a Shield equal to 60% of the wearer's Max HP to all on-field allies for 2 turn(s).

name: Adaptive Exoskeleton
d:
At the start of combat, if the wearer is on-field, they gain 25% DMG Mitigation and have a higher chance to be attacked.
If the wearer is off-field, their Off-Field Strength increases by 20% and SPD Amplification increases by 20%.

name: Adaptive Exoskeleton: Privilege
d:
At the start of combat, if the wearer is on-field, they gain 50% DMG Mitigation and have a higher chance to be attacked.
If the wearer is off-field, their Off-Field Strength increases by 40% and SPD Amplification increases by 40%.

name: Decapitation Operation
d: The wearer's DMG Amplification increases by 30%, and they gain an additional 30% in Encounter and Boss Nodes.

name: Decapitation Operation: Privilege
d: The wearer's DMG Amplification increases by 60%, and they gain an additional 60% in Encounter and Boss Nodes.

name: Charging Sail
d: The wearer regenerates 2 Energy for each action value spent. (Unique)

name: Charging Sail: Privilege
d: The wearer regenerates 4 Energy for each action value spent. (Unique)

name: Whatever Dice
d: At each Node, Whatever Dice randomly equips the character with two items (requires empty equipment slot to equip Whatever Dice).

name: Whatever Dice: Privilege
d: At each Node, Whatever Dice: Privilege randomly equips the character with two privileged equipment (requires empty equipment slot to equip Whatever Dice: Privilege).

name: Fist of Fury
d: While the wearer's Max HP exceeds 5000, every 1000 HP increases Lucky Strike Rate by 2%, up to 60%.

name: Fist of Fury: Privilege
d: While the wearer's Max HP exceeds 5000, every 1000 HP increases Lucky Strike Rate by 4%, up to 100%.

name: Chassis of Retribution
d: At the start of combat, all on-field allies gain a Shield equal to 300% of the wearer's DEF. When the wearer is attacked, deals Physical DMG to the attacker equal to 250% of the Shield Effect before the attack. This DMG cannot defeat enemy targets.

name: Chassis of Retribution: Privilege
d: At the start of combat, all on-field allies gain a Shield equal to 600% of the wearer's DEF. When the wearer is attacked, deals Physical DMG to the attacker equal to 500% of the Shield Effect before the attack. This DMG cannot defeat enemy targets.

name: Victory Banner
d: Increases ally squad's Lucky Strike Rate by 12% and resists 4 instance(s) of Crowd Control debuffs. This effect is stackable.

name: Victory Banner: Privilege
d: Increases ally squad's Lucky Strike Rate by 24% and resists 8 instance(s) of Crowd Control debuffs. This effect is stackable.

name: Pun Generator
d: Every time the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the wearer's Lucky Strike Rate by 10%. After increasing 5 time(s), subsequent uses instead increase Lucky Strike DMG by 8%.

name: Pun Generator: Privilege
d: Every time the wearer uses their Ultimate, increases the wearer's Lucky Strike Rate by 20%. After increasing 5 time(s), subsequent uses instead increase Lucky Strike DMG by 16%.

name: Ring of Life
d: Increases ally squad's Max HP by 15%.

name: Ring of Life: Privilege
d: Increases ally squad's Max HP by 30%.

name: Analgesia Chip
d: After the wearer heals an ally target or grants a Shield to them, grants them 15% DMG Mitigation for 2 turn(s).

name: Analgesia Chip: Privilege
d: After the wearer heals an ally target or grants a Shield to them, grants them 30% DMG Mitigation for 2 turn(s).

name: Molecular Solvent
d: The wearer's first attack each turn deals True DMG to one random target equal to 3% of their Max HP.

name: Molecular Solvent: Privilege
d: The wearer's first attack each turn deals True DMG to one random target equal to 6% of their Max HP.

name: Caloric Overload
d: When ally squad takes action, restore HP equal to 12% of the wearer's Max HP. After the wearer uses Ultimate, regenerate 10 Energy. (Unique)

name: Caloric Overload: Privilege
d: When ally squad takes action, restore HP equal to 24% of the wearer's Max HP. After the wearer uses Ultimate, regenerate 20 Energy. (Unique)

name: Sturdy Plate
d: The ally squad gains 18% DMG Mitigation.

name: Sturdy Plate: Privilege
d: The ally squad gains 36% DMG Mitigation.

name: Flash Grenade
d: After entering combat, enemies become "Weakened," reducing their DMG dealt by 20%.

name: Flash Grenade: Privilege
d: After entering combat, enemies become "Weakened," reducing their DMG dealt by 40%.

name: Photon Shield
d: When an on-field ally's HP drops below 50% of their Max HP, the wearer provides a Shield equal to 300% of their DEF that lasts for 2 turn(s). This effect can be triggered up to 5 time(s). When on-field allies have Shield, they are immune to the action delay effects.

name: Photon Shield: Privilege
d: When an on-field ally's HP drops below 50% of their Max HP, the wearer provides a Shield equal to 600% of their DEF that lasts for 2 turn(s). This effect can be triggered up to 10 time(s). When on-field allies have Shield, they are immune to the action delay effects.

name: Wormhole Drill
d: Greatly increases Weakness Break Efficiency. Increases Break Effect by 250%.

name: Wormhole Drill: Privilege
d: Greatly increases Weakness Break Efficiency. Increases Break Effect by 500%.

name: Planetary Drill
d: After attacking, the wearer inflicts "Fragility" on the target, increasing their DMG taken by 35% for 2 turn(s).

name: Planetary Drill: Privilege
d: After attacking, the wearer inflicts "Fragility" on the target, increasing their DMG taken by 70% for 2 turn(s).

name: Perpetual Engine
d: When entering combat, activates the wearer's Ultimate. After using 3 Ultimates, activates their Ultimate again. Ultimates activated by equipment will not count towards the number of uses.

name: Perpetual Engine: Privilege
d: When entering combat, activates the wearer's Ultimate. After using 3 Ultimates, activates their Ultimate again. Ultimates activated by equipment will not count towards the number of uses.

name: Anti-Spiral Step
d: Each time the wearer uses a Basic ATK or Skill, DMG Amplification increases by 5%. This effect is stackable.

name: Anti-Spiral Step: Privilege
d: Each time the wearer uses a Basic ATK or Skill, DMG Amplification increases by 10%. This effect is stackable.

name: Uncalled Mask
d:
The wearer gains bonuses based on their Path:
Remembrance: The On/Off-Field Strength of the wearer and their memosprite increases by 80%.
Elation: Elation increases by 60% and Elation DMG Amplification increases by 40%.
Others: 35% DMG Mitigation.
(Unique Equipment)

name: Uncalled Mask: Privilege
d:
The wearer gains bonuses based on their Path:
Remembrance: The On/Off-Field Strength of the wearer and their memosprite increases by 160%.
Elation: Elation increases by 120% and Elation DMG Amplification increases by 80%.
Others: 60% DMG Mitigation.
(Unique Equipment)

name: Colossal Imagenated Armor
d: After the wearer is attacked by an enemy target or consumes HP, gains 6% On/Off-Field Strength. This effect is stackable and can only be triggered 1 time per action.

name: Colossal Imagenated Armor: Privilege
d: After the wearer is attacked by an enemy target or consumes HP, gains 12% On/Off-Field Strength. This effect is stackable and can only be triggered 1 time per action.

name: Xianzhou Fleet Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Xianzhou Fleet" Bond.

name: Beast Garden Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Beast Garden" Bond.

name: Phantasmoon Games Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Phantasmoon Games" Bond.

name: Galactic Voyager Emblem
d: Grants wearer the "Galactic Voyager" Bond.

name: Trailblaze Silver Rail Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Trailblaze Silver Rail" Bond.

name: Astropolis Merchant Guild Emblem
d: Grants wearer the "Astropolis Merchant Guild" Bond.

name: Stellaron Hunters Emblem
d: Grants wearer the "Stellaron Hunters" Bond.

name: Little Giant Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Little Giant" Bond. Increases the wearer's On/Off-Field Strength by 20% for every point of "Height."

name: Intertwined Dreamscapes Emblem
d: Grants wearer the "Intertwined Dreamscapes" Bond.

name: The Grand Restaurant Emblem
d: Grants wearer the "The Grand Restaurant" Bond.

name: Follow-Up ATK Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Follow-Up ATK" Bond. After attacking, deals Additional DMG equal to 100% of ATK. After defeating an enemy target, their action advances by 50%.

name: DoT Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "DoT" Bond. After attacking, inflicts "Freeze" on the attack target: DEF decreases by 20%, and deals Ice DoT equal to 200% of the wearer's ATK at the start of this unit's turn.

name: AoE Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "AoE ATK" Bond. After using an attack, for each enemy target hit by this attack, On/Off-Field Strength increases by 2%. This effect can stack up to 50 time(s).

name: Combo Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Combo" Bond. Gains 20% base "Combo Rate", and DMG dealt in the extra turn from Combo increases by 50%.

name: Break Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Break" Bond. Break Effect increases by 100%. When an enemy target is Weakness Broken by the wearer for the first time, they take True DMG equal to 8% of their Max HP.

name: Summon Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Summon" Bond. For every 1 ally target, DMG dealt by the wearer and their memosprite increases by 8%.

name: Elation Emblem
d:
Grants the wearer the "Elation" Bond. When entering combat, grants the ally squad 25% Elation.
Obtains the "Euphoric Maelstrom" Elation Skill, which deals Elation DMG equal to 100% of the wearer's stats to all enemies.

name: Counter Emblem
d:
Grants the wearer the "Counter" Bond.
When combat begins, if the wearer is on-field: After being attacked by an enemy target, their action advances by 10% and DMG dealt increases by 20%, lasting for 1 turn(s) and stackable up to 10 time(s).
If the wearer is off-field: Causes "Counter King" to ignore 30% of the enemy target's DEF when attacking.

name: Energy Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Energy" Bond. After using Ultimate, regenerates Energy for all allies equal to 20% of their respective Max Energy. After this effect is triggered, 100 action value must pass before it can be triggered again.

name: Healing Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Heal" Bond. When taking action, restores HP for all on-field allies by an amount equal to 10% of the wearer's Max HP.

name: Defender Emblem
d: Grants the wearer the "Defender" Bond. At the start of combat, provides all on-field allies with a Shield equal to 200% of the wearer's DEF. During combat, the wearer gains DMG Amplification equal to this unit's Shield effect × 0.2%.
